## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve the Boris architecture.
- [ ] Content changes preserve canonical IDs, the supported schema, and evidence standards (or are not applicable).
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private source payloads, or generated outputs are included.
- [ ] Validation results and unresolved blockers are recorded above.
- [ ] Before merging: at least one approval and the required `Validate & Build Site` check are present.
